caption: The canvas of a pitched tent lights up from a lightning flash outside, then goes dark again.

sa.check: A pitched tent, its canvas in view.
The canvas lights up from a flash outside.
The tent is dim before the flash.
The order is dim, lit, dark again.

pc.expect: The glow on the canvas is brief: it appears and is gone, and the canvas returns to dim; flashes may repeat but each ends.
pc.fail: The canvas stays lit for the rest of the clip after the flash; or brightens steadily; or the flash fades in slowly like a lantern being turned up; or the canvas glows on after the sky is dark.

pc.expect: The canvas is brightest on the side toward the flash and dimmer on the far side; the light shows through the fabric with the poles and seams as dark lines.
pc.fail: The canvas lights evenly all round with no brighter side; or the side away from the lit sky is the brightest; or the canvas lights up while the sky around the tent stays dark; or the glow sits at one spot on the canvas like a lamp inside.

pc.expect: The tent and its surroundings stay still at the flash; the canvas may ripple in the wind but does not jump at the flash.
pc.fail: The tent shifts or its poles move at the flash; or objects around the tent jump; or the canvas snaps taut or collapses at the instant of the flash.

pc.expect: The tent, the ground and the surroundings are the same across dim and lit frames.
pc.fail: Trees or objects around the tent appear or vanish between frames; or the tent changes place; or a second tent appears; or a figure appears inside the tent at the flash.

pc.expect: The tent keeps its shape and the canvas stays cloth; nothing passes through it.
pc.fail: The tent changes shape between frames; or the canvas becomes a solid wall or turns transparent like glass; or a bolt passes through the tent; or the tent merges with the ground.

pc.expect: The canvas colour, the ground and the surroundings keep their colours apart from brightness.
pc.fail: The canvas changes colour rather than brightness; or the ground changes colour; or the tent's pattern or logo changes.
